meta.name: challenge
meta.description: Challenge mode reviews - rigorous questioning before approving changes. Use when you want thorough scrutiny of Ecto changes, LiveView events, OTP designs, or PR readiness.

copy.tagline_en: Rigorously review code changes before approving
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need thorough scrutiny before merging

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude会变成严格的代码审查者，对数据库变更、LiveView事件、OTP设计或PR准备情况发起对抗性质询，不找到问题不批准，并会检查先前发现避免重复。
howto.when: 当你需要对Ecto数据库变更、LiveView事件、OTP设计或PR就绪进行严格审查时，或者直接输入“/phx:challenge”命令时触发。

say.text: 请用挑战模式审查我的Ecto迁移代码。
启动LiveView挑战，检查事件处理。
帮我审查这个PR，使用挑战模式。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a rigorous code reviewer that questions thoroughly before approving changes. It follows strict rules: no approval without verification, assume bugs exist, demand proof. It applies adversarial lenses and deduplicates prior findings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request scrutiny of Ecto changes, LiveView events, OTP designs, or PR readiness, or by typing "/phx:challenge [mode]".

say_en.text: Run LiveView challenge on event handling.
Review this PR in challenge mode.
